CustomField.description: Attaches a PDF of the respondent's answers to the confirmation email. Used only when Send Confirmation Email is also on: the Form_Submission_Convert_Utility_Send_Email_Overridable flow renders the Form Submission Simple Print page for the submission, saves it as a file on the submission (visible to anyone who can see the submission) and attaches it to the email. The PDF page needs a running user with access to the package's classes, so the Form Submission Convert trigger's running user must be set to a system administrator with a Platform Event Subscriber Config; under the default Automated Process user the PDF cannot be made. If the PDF cannot be made, the email still sends without it and a warning is logged on the submission. Orgs that override the send flow must copy its Attach PDF steps into their own flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When on, the confirmation email carries a PDF of the respondent's answers, also saved in the submission's Files. Needs the confirmation's running user set to a system administrator (Set Up Email Notifications in the Flow Tool Kit docs); without it, the email sends with no PDF and a warning is logged.
CustomField.label: Attach PDF to Confirmation Email
